club.ops.unavailable.zh-Hans: 俱乐部运营服务尚未配置。

club.ops.discardMessage.en: Unsaved changes will be discarded. Leaving does not cancel a request already sent. An uncertain request stays locked.
club.ops.discardMessage.zh-Hans: 未保存的修改将丢弃。离开不会取消已发送的请求，结果不明确的请求将继续锁定。

club.ops.leaderRequired.en: Creating a club requires a server-confirmed club leader role. The leader application is not connected here.
club.ops.leaderRequired.zh-Hans: 创建俱乐部需要服务端确认的主理人身份，此处尚未接入主理人申请。

club.ops.clubLimit.en: You already own two clubs. Manage an existing club instead.
club.ops.clubLimit.zh-Hans: 你已创建两个俱乐部，请管理现有俱乐部。

club.ops.mediaUnavailable.en: Media uploads are not connected. Existing logo and cover references are preserved.
club.ops.mediaUnavailable.zh-Hans: 图片上传尚未接入，将保留现有标志和封面。

club.ops.settingsHint.en: Each change is reviewed separately. Only a fresh server read can establish the current setting.
club.ops.settingsHint.zh-Hans: 每项设置单独核对，以服务端最新读取值为准。

club.ops.membersUnavailable.en: The member list is unavailable or empty. No member action is inferred.
club.ops.membersUnavailable.zh-Hans: 成员列表为空或暂不可用，不推断可操作的成员。

club.ops.adminHint.en: Only the owner can change legacy administrator roles. At most two non-owner administrators are supported.
club.ops.adminHint.zh-Hans: 仅创建者可调整旧版管理员角色，最多支持两名非创建者管理员。

club.ops.writeGated.en: Backend submissions are not enabled. You can inspect this form and its review, but it will not change a real club.
club.ops.writeGated.zh-Hans: 服务端提交尚未开放。可以填写和核对表单，但不会修改真实俱乐部。

club.ops.notSent.en: Nothing was submitted. Refresh current club information before trying again.
club.ops.notSent.zh-Hans: 未提交任何修改，请先刷新俱乐部信息。

club.ops.acknowledged.en: Request acknowledged. The current values below come from a separate read.
club.ops.acknowledged.zh-Hans: 请求已获回执，下方当前值来自独立读取。

club.ops.outcomeUnknown.en: The request outcome is unknown. Do not submit it again. Reading current values does not prove whether this request succeeded.
club.ops.outcomeUnknown.zh-Hans: 请求结果不明确，请勿再次提交。读取当前值不能证明本次请求是否成功。

club.ops.readbackUnavailable.en: Acknowledgment was received, but the latest club data could not be read. No saved value is assumed.
club.ops.readbackUnavailable.zh-Hans: 已收到回执，但无法读取最新俱乐部数据，不推断保存后的值。

club.ops.readFailed.en: Could not read the club information. Try again.
club.ops.readFailed.zh-Hans: 无法读取俱乐部信息，请重试。

club.ops.directionsHint.en: Choose up to three. Existing legacy preferences are preserved until changed.
club.ops.directionsHint.zh-Hans: 最多选择三项，未修改的旧版方向将保留。

club.ops.joinPolicyUnavailable.en: This club has not reported support for changing its joining policy.
club.ops.joinPolicyUnavailable.zh-Hans: 此俱乐部未声明支持修改加入方式。

club.ops.fixtureOnly.en: Offline synthetic club operations. No real data or backend requests.
club.ops.fixtureOnly.zh-Hans: 离线合成俱乐部流程，不使用真实数据或服务端请求。

club.ops.roleConsequences.en: This would change this member’s club administration privileges. The fixture only simulates that change.
club.ops.roleConsequences.zh-Hans: 此操作会变更该成员的俱乐部管理权限，演示仅在本地模拟。

club.ops.mediaPreserved.en: Existing logo and cover are preserved. This review does not upload media.
club.ops.mediaPreserved.zh-Hans: 保留现有标志和封面，此核对不会上传图片。

club.ops.settingConsequences.publicVisib.en: This affects whether people can discover the club publicly.
club.ops.settingConsequences.publicVisib.zh-Hans: 这会影响其他人是否能公开发现此俱乐部。

club.ops.settingConsequences.memberPostA.en: This affects whether members can post in the club.
club.ops.settingConsequences.memberPostA.zh-Hans: 这会影响成员是否可以在俱乐部发帖。

club.ops.settingConsequences.merchantUnd.en: This affects whether merchant cooperation is open for the club.
club.ops.settingConsequences.merchantUnd.zh-Hans: 这会影响俱乐部是否开放商家承接。

club.ops.error.textTooLong.en: One or more fields exceed the displayed character limit.
club.ops.error.textTooLong.zh-Hans: 部分字段超过所示字数限制。

club.ops.error.invalidSelection.en: Choose a supported type and at most three distinct preferences.
club.ops.error.invalidSelection.zh-Hans: 请选择有效类型，路线方向最多三项且不能重复。

club.ops.error.invalidQuota.en: Reserved places must be a non-negative whole number.
club.ops.error.invalidQuota.zh-Hans: 保留名额必须为非负整数。

club.ops.error.mediaUnavailable.en: Media uploads are not connected. Existing logo and cover references are preserved.
club.ops.error.mediaUnavailable.zh-Hans: 图片上传尚未接入，将保留现有标志和封面。

club.ops.error.unavailable.zh-Hans: 俱乐部运营服务尚未配置。

club.ops.error.createUnavailable.en: The current account cannot create another club.
club.ops.error.createUnavailable.zh-Hans: 当前账号无法再创建俱乐部。

club.ops.error.forbidden.en: Your current club role does not allow this action.
club.ops.error.forbidden.zh-Hans: 当前俱乐部身份无权执行此操作。

club.ops.error.changed.en: Club data or access changed. Close and reopen the form to review current information.
club.ops.error.changed.zh-Hans: 俱乐部数据或权限已变化，请关闭后重新打开表单核对最新信息。

club.ops.error.adminLimit.en: Two administrators are already assigned. Remove an existing role before adding another.
club.ops.error.adminLimit.zh-Hans: 已有两名管理员，请先取消一名管理员角色。

club.ops.error.pending.en: A request is already pending or has an unknown outcome. Do not submit again.
club.ops.error.pending.zh-Hans: 请求正在处理中或结果不明确，请勿重复提交。

club.ops.error.staleReview.en: This review has expired. Review current information again.
club.ops.error.staleReview.zh-Hans: 此核对已过期，请重新核对当前信息。

club.ops.error.cancelled.en: The local review was interrupted before submission.
club.ops.error.cancelled.zh-Hans: 本地核对已中断，未提交。

club.ops.confirmLiveHint.en: Apply the reviewed club changes to the server.
club.ops.confirmLiveHint.zh-Hans: 将已核对的俱乐部更改提交至服务器。
